Description: A visual quadrupole approximation of binary gravitational waves: plus and cross polarization shear the clone field while a fading wavefront ripples through space.
KScript: var radius := sqrt(x*x + y*y + z*z) + 1.0; var phase := v0*radius - t*v1 + u*v2; var envelope := exp(-radius/max(v3,1.0)); var plus := sin(phase)*envelope*v4; var cross := cos(phase+v5)*envelope*v4; var ox := x; var oy := y; x := ox + ox*plus + oy*cross; y := oy + oy*plus - ox*cross; z += sin(phase*0.5)*envelope*v6; rz += (plus-cross)*v7;

Variables.Name: WaveNumber
Variables.Tooltip: Spatial frequency of the passing wave
